headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text:
The SW YMCA has temporarily parking for handicapped until 11:00 AM
My previous request for investigation didn’t see an issue. Does that mean it’s okay for non handicapped designated vehicles to park as they continue to do on a daily basis?

Multiple pothole repair.  How much longer until the city repairs this longstanding issue?? Planned cut mentioned before but no progress in over a year, lets get this done already before the road gets worse than it already is.

Trail signage needs to be adjusted. The yield sign for hikers/bikers is too high so people dont see it. This should also be a stop sign instead of yield for greater safety. Many bikers come off the trail at high speed and dont look for oncoming vehicles on Jain Lane. This yield sign is on the north side of the intersection.

Park Map Signage damaged. This is about a 100 feet from the concrete Northern Walnut Creek Urban trail, which also has a kiosk for signage. Therefore you could remove this sign as unneeded (it was installed before the concrete trail was). What Three Words location:

https://w3w.co/snares.backup.twig

Traveling on W. 35th St. going west, and just before the Street dead ends at Laguna Gloria art museum on the right hand side the pavement disappears into a ditch. In other words, there’s a couple of feet from the pavement to the embankment, and I would hate for anyone’s tire to go into that ditch and chop up the underside of their vehicle.

Large pickup is parked at an angle in the cul-de-sac with the passenger-side wheels substantially more than 18 inches from the curb. The vehicle extends well into the roadway and is restricting the turning radius and making it difficult for vehicles to enter, exit, and turn around in the cul-de-sac. Please send parking enforcement to inspect.

per, Request #26-00323862 --- photo of violatir taken on 10/05/2026.  please patrol this street periodically for weight limit violators on N. Lake Creek Prkwy 78717. also, i do not see license plates on some if these large commercial trucks that have been rotinely parking on this street.

Lady walking a German shepherd & other black dog. When trying to pass (she was on her phone w/ ear buds)& her GS dog aggressively lunged for my dogs throat & bit my dog. She had no control of her dogs as they went behind her before attacking. Then she started yelling & swearing at us. We were trying to pass safely but Bluebonnet Ln is a double yellow street w/ cars. Please install bike lane bollards on Braker Ln. between Mopac and Kramer. I know that is a big stretch but the bike lane is too thin and traffic moves too fast for it to be safe. Bicyclists use the sidewalk on that stretch a lot more as a result

An adult raccoon has been wandering. The creek with an aluminum can stuck on his head. He has mostly been in and around where the red lifejacket is hanging from the trees. There is a drainage ditch at the bottom of the Twin Oaks Blvd. Dead ends into the creek where I think he lives and is trying to get to. Attached is a screenshot of the location and area he has been in.

Austin came and fixed the water main several months ago and left this area completely unusable and also the driveway to my place of business needs to be fixed it's all cracked up however asphalt and the hole in the dirt was done by the City of Austin.

Why has the bridge on Jain Lane been reduced to one lane to accommodate two bike lanes? This is a very highly trafficked road during morning and afternoon hours with the schools. This needs to be corrected.

The No Parking signs for ACL in the 1700 block of Kerr are confusing parkers. Signs are on Kerr at Kinney and then half up Kerr. However, in the 1800 black of Kerr there is parking on both sides. I suggest you either add another sign near Garner and Kerr or move the existing mod point sign to that location. I had to point the sign out to several people. Neighborhood Restrictions & Enforcement
• Prohibited Areas: The City of Austin bans non-resident parking in adjacent neighborhoods including Zilker, Barton Hills, Bouldin Creek, and Rollingwood.

Vehicle has been used continuously as a living accommodation/camping on a public street for over 72 hours in violation of Austin City Code § 12-5-11 and § 9-4-11.

This is an encampment with vehicles that cannot be legal literally steps away from the site that an officer was shot and nearly lead to a school shooting at Barton Hills.  A permanent homeless car camping community is being set up here endangering children playing baseball here.

Request arm style street lamp on Ross road at intersection of fort Lexington dr/Gilwell due to city long term construction on unlit blind curve with 3 schools on street after pedestrian death by Del Valle high school crossing Ross. City closed st thomas crossing at Ross so there is zero way for pedestrians to get into Lexington neighborhood.

About a week ago, I called and reported a huge oak tree lodged in the creek behind my house. A gentleman came out and looked at it and said he would have a crew come and have the tree removed plus clear out all the debris that is collecting. No one has showed up now for over seven days and more debris is collecting around this large tree.

Jay Carpenter 
4701 Hilwin Circle 
Austin, Texas 78756

Trash and overgrown, weeds, and drainage channel. This drainage channel needs to be maintained and gets blocked up during large rain storms now it’s collecting trash that’s bad for our wildlife as well

Unsure if this is an issue related to the manholes structure, or a roadway issue.
Discarded furniture has been on the corner of this location for over six months. It is on a sidewalk to Patton Elementary. Is an eyesore and possible home for wild animals and pests. Needs removal.

I reported these potholes over a year ago under 25-00213653 and that ticket was closed stating this road was part of future repairs… yet these potholes are still there in the middle of the road and the road has not been repaired.

Previously filled pothole has sunken in and made a new pothole. Located near the fire department and Torchy’s Tacos on spicewood Springs Road.  Picture shows two patches, the one farthest away has turned into a pothole again.

The right of way is overgrown on this City of Austin property

At Gillis & Redd street on the north west & north east corners. Vegetation needs to be cut back because it is blocking line of sight when headed south in Gillis at the stop sign at Redd street

The Fairmont has been blasting music for a couple hours at its pool, so loud that we can clearly hear all lyrics inside a couple buildings away with all doors and windows closed. The bass is so heavy that it’s shaking.

Made complaint of animals from a neighbor being in my yard constantly , my yard is NOT their property or their animals home.  , contact was not made before and animals were not seen this is days after .
License XFJ9331 black jeep (maybe Cherokee). Keeps parking in the bike lane. Every week. Please do something about it this time!
